title: Shooter in C Wing — Halverson High School

lines.text: EOC, this is 911 Central. A call came in from Halverson High School main office at 07:38:02. Caller ID: (541) 555-0140 (HUSD Main Office). Message: 'There's a shooter in C Wing, I can hear gunshots, someone's bleeding.' Call was received and recorded, but HUSD-PBX01 is now down—no callback possible. HPD and Brandt County Sheriff are en route.

instructorNote: This inject triggers full EOC activation and initiates the reunification protocol. The SRO must trace the spoofed PBX call to HUSD-PBX01 (10.72.10.15) and confirm it is not a valid internal line. The DSS must declare S4 Critical per EOP 6.4.
